k:一.mnemonic: A single horizontal stroke. One line, one finger held sideways, one of anything. This is the kanji for one.

k:人.mnemonic: Two legs striding forward, seen from the side. No arms, no head, just a body walking: a person.

k:大.mnemonic: A person (人) stretching both arms out wide to show you how BIG it was. That fish was this big.

k:日.mnemonic: A window with the sun shining through it. The sun rules the day, so this kanji means day (and also sun).

k:月.mnemonic: A crescent moon with two little lines inside, the shadows on its face. The moon takes a month to go through its phases, so this is month (and also moon).

k:上.mnemonic: A divining rod standing on top of one (一) line, the ground. The rod points up, above the ground. Above.
k:上.hint: Rod standing on the ground line.

k:口.mnemonic: A wide-open mouth, square because a cartoon mouth is easier to draw square. Mouth.

k:中.mnemonic: A stick shoved straight through the middle of a mouth (口), like a skewer through a marshmallow. Middle.
k:中.hint: Stick through the middle of a mouth.

k:木.mnemonic: A trunk with branches reaching up and roots reaching down. Tree.

k:本.mnemonic: A tree (木) with one (一) extra line across its roots, marking the base. Books are made from the base of trees, and the base of something is its origin. Book.
k:本.hint: A tree marked at its root.

k:山.mnemonic: Three peaks rising from the ground, the middle one tallest. Mountain.

k:出.mnemonic: A mountain (山) stacked on top of a pit (凵). You climb out of the pit and over the mountain to get out of here: exit.
k:出.hint: Climb out of the pit over the mountain.

k:子.mnemonic: A baby wrapped up tight, arms out wide and legs bundled into one line. Child.
k:子.hint: A swaddled baby with its arms out.

k:干.mnemonic: A clothes rack: two horizontal bars on a pole. You hang washing on it to dry. Dry.

k:年.mnemonic: A hairpin (𠂉) stuck into the dry (干) rack. Every year you take the winter coats off the rack and pin them up to dry. Year.

k:手.mnemonic: A hand seen palm-on, with the fingers spread and the wrist hanging down. Hand.

k:生.mnemonic: A sprout pushing up out of the ground line, with new leaves opening. New growth is life (and birth, and things that are raw and fresh).
k:生.hint: A sprout breaking through the soil.

k:入.mnemonic: The shape of a doorway seen from inside, with the flap bending in. It looks like person (人) but the left stroke ducks under the right one, entering. Enter.

k:下.mnemonic: Above (上) flipped over, with the stick hanging down below the ground line. Below.

k:刀.mnemonic: A curved blade with a handle at the top. Sword.

k:分.mnemonic: A sword (刀) with two fins (ハ) flying off the top. The sword has just chopped something clean in two, and each piece is a part. (Minutes are parts of an hour.)

k:行.mnemonic: A crossroads seen from above, with a stroll (彳) on the left and a straight road on the right. At the crossroads you pick a road and go.
